name: Liner Trade Schedule Gantt View — Visual Voyage Timeline

content.description: Add a visual Gantt-style timeline to the schedule engine dashboard that shows all generated voyages as horizontal bars across a date axis. Each voyage row shows port call segments color-coded by status. Operations teams use this to visualize vessel utilization, identify scheduling gaps, and spot delays at a glance. Uses pure CSS/div positioning (no recharts — Gantt is not a chart type recharts supports natively).
acceptance_criteria: New component: ScheduleGantt.tsx — client component ('use client') rendering voyage timeline
Component receives voyages array from server component (no client-side fetching)
X-axis shows date range with day markers, auto-scales to fit all voyages (min 14 days, max 90 days)
Each voyage = one horizontal row with voyage number label on left
Port call segments within each voyage bar show: port code label, colored by status (scheduled=blue, arrived=amber, departed=green, completed=gray)
Hover tooltip on each port segment shows: port name, planned arrival, planned departure, cargo cutoff, delay hours if any
Today marker: vertical red dashed line showing current date
Row height: 40px per voyage, scrollable if >10 voyages
Responsive: horizontal scroll on small screens, min-width 800px for the timeline area
Empty state: 'No voyages generated yet' message with link to templates page
Loading skeleton while data fetches (Suspense boundary in parent)
Integrated into existing schedule-engine/page.tsx below the KPI cards, replacing or supplementing the voyages table
API: Reuse existing GET /api/v1/schedule-engine/voyages + per-voyage port calls, OR add a single endpoint that returns voyages with embedded port calls
edge_cases: Voyage with only 1 port call — renders as single dot/narrow bar
Voyages spanning different date ranges — auto-calculate min/max dates from all voyages
Port calls with actual times filled — show actual arrival/departure in tooltip alongside planned
Delayed port calls (delayHours > 0) — show warning icon or red border on segment
Blank sailing voyages (isBlankSailing=true) — show striped/hashed bar pattern
Extra loader voyages (isExtraLoader=true) — show dashed border
No voyages at all — empty state
100+ voyages — virtual scrolling not needed (max ~52 per year per service), just overflow-y scroll
Timezone: all dates displayed in UTC (server timestamps are timestamptz)
error_handling: API fetch failure: show error alert with retry button (server component error boundary)
Invalid date range: clamp to reasonable bounds (no negative widths)
Port calls without planned arrival: skip segment, don't crash
Division by zero on date range: guard with Math.max(range, 1)
affected_files: src/app/(dashboard)/schedule-engine/page.tsx — MODIFY: add Gantt below KPI cards
src/app/api/v1/schedule-engine/voyages/route.ts — MODIFY: add ?include=portCalls query param to embed port calls in voyage response
content.implementation_notes: Pure div-based Gantt with absolute positioning. Each port call segment is positioned as: left = (arrivalDate - rangeStart) / totalRange * 100%, width = (departureDate - arrivalDate) / totalRange * 100%. Color via Tailwind classes. No external charting library needed — simpler, smaller bundle, more control over shipping-specific display.
